body: Opus2 long fan-in rule (agreed with Fable2 #5342, 2026-11-10): before opening any termal_resume_after_delegations wait likely to exceed ~15 min (e.g. a composite review pair), announce it at SPAWN to Fable2 and Engram::Fable with the expected end time. Fable2 stands in for TermAl slot scheduling during that window (Engram::Fable for Engram slots) and hands back at the fan-in. Reason: while the wait is open, the session's mailbox queue is held behind it (heldBehindPausedQueue), as on 16:23-17:37Z. Product fix filed as w-c2687bb9a855.
